tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder should have the liquid assets as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid consisting of Cash at Bank plus Term Deposits plus availability of fund based credit facility in any Nationalized/scheduled Commercial Bank shall not be less than 25% of amount put to tender. The cash at bank, Term Deposits and the availability of fund based credit facility shall be supported by a certificate issued by any Nationalized/Scheduled Bank with whom the Bidder has banking facilities. In case of Fund based credit facility, the certificate issued by the Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid. The balance available as on as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid shall be considered as availability of fund based credit facility. If the bidder has banking with more than one Bank, then the available liquid assets as mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on as on the date of issue of Notification for Inviting Tender (NIT) or later date before submission of bid shall be the same date for all the banks.

Litigation History: Bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years i.e. FY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder may result in rejection of Bid. The bidder shall upload notarized Self-declaration on Rs. 500/- stamp paper as per the enclosed format.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following:a)Company incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment thereto 1.Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956/2013 along with Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the Company.2.Annual filings (E-Forms AOC-4, MGT-7) filed by the Company to Registrar of Companies (Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India) for preceding two Financial Years.3.Declaration from Directors of the Company stating that they are not disqualified to be a Director of the Company along with the list of Companies in which they are Directors as on the date of inviting tender (s). b)LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto: 1.Certification of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per LLP Act 2008.2.Limited Liability Partnership Agreement of LLP.3.Form 11-Annual Return filed by LLP to Registrar of Companies (Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India) for preceding two Financial Years. c)Partnership Firm under Partnership Act, 1932 in India:1.Partnership Deed, GST Registration Certificate.2.Shops & Establishment Registration Certificate, as applicable. d)Sole Proprietorship Concern 1.PAN/GST Registration Certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder as OEM or authorized representative of a SD-WAN Manufacturer should have supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 631 Nos of SD-WAN devices in any SCADA/IT/OT projects in any sector in any one of the last three years (FY 2023-24 to 2025-26). The commissioned equipment should be in satisfactory operation for 6 months as on the date of tender opening. Relaxation for Startup/MSME: However, it will be 316 Nos with respect to Startup/Micro, Small Enterprises in any one of the last two preceding years (FY 2024-25 to 2025-26). The commissioned equipment should be in satisfactory operation for 6 months as on the date of tender opening. Startup Certificate/Udyam Registration certificate or any other documents to substantiate the same to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Detailed Work Award(s) and connected Satisfactory performance certificate(s) to be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should submit the MAF (Manufacturer Authorization Form) with the OEM of the remote end equipment subject fulfillment of the following conditions. a.Manufacture of the Remote End Equipment should have ISO 9001:2015 certificate. b. Manufacture of the Remote End Equipment should have MTCTE certificate issued by Ministry of Telecommunication.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- MAF signed by OEM to be uploaded along with Power of Attorney
Others -- Valid ISO 9001:2015 certificate should be submitted
Others -- Valid MTCTE certificate should be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have achieved an average annual turnover of not less than amount put to tender in preceding three financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 to FY 2025-26. Note: Updated to FY 2026-27. The financial turnover shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level to FY 2026-27. Relaxation for Startup/MSME: However, average annual turnover will not be less than 50% of amount put to tender with respect to Startup/Micro, Small Enterprises in last two preceding financial years (2024-25, 2025-26). Startup Certificate/Udyam Registration certificate or any other documents to substantiate the same to be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Even though the Bidders meet the above criteria, they are subject to be disqualified if they have: i)made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and/or ii) record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history, or financial failures etc. and/or iii) Participated in the previous Tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification. and/or iv) Blacklisted due to non-performance in execution of works by any sector as on date of bid submission. and/or v) Defaulted/short closed due to non-performance in execution of works against the order placed by any sector as on date of bid submission. Copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- as per the format in the bid document shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any Bidder from a country, which shares a land with India, will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority. (As per Government Order No. FD 455 Exp-12/2020 dated 25.08.2020.) A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted/uploaded by the Bidder separately in the following format. I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country, which shares a land border with India. I certify that this Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached.) Copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- as per the format in the bid document shall be uploaded. If the Bidder from a country which shares a land with India, Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.
